evidence.statement: The 120-frame null-HMD main-menu capture recorded the shader types, descriptor pairs, pass values, caller return addresses, and exact repeated event order used in this seed.
CommonLib defines BSShader type values, virtual SetupTechnique slot 2, the Lighting and Utility class contracts, and Skyrim VR vtable offsets used to identify the observed functions.

The Skyrim VR PDB and a full-memory reference dump identify BSLightingShader::SetupTechnique, BSShader::BeginTechnique, BSImagespaceShader's slot-2 function, vtable slot 2 for Utility, and containing functions for all six caller RVAs.

Disassembly of the runtime-decrypted Skyrim image proves that each captured caller RVA follows a call to BSShader::BeginTechnique and that BeginTechnique performs descriptor-keyed shader lookup before binding vertex and pixel shader objects.
The deterministic shader manifest maps Effect, Lighting, and Utility engine-cache families to compile units and passes 0074, 0115, and 0120 respectively.
ShaderCache source defines the descriptor bitfields, macro expansion, cache naming, and image-space descriptor resolution used to decode the captured keys.

Pinned CommonLibSSE-NG headers define the exact VR class sizes, inheritance declarations, virtual slots, member layouts, vtable RVAs, and relocation IDs for the culling hierarchy, shader accumulator, and batch renderer.

The exact Skyrim VR coverage overlay assigns culling, shader-accumulator, batch-renderer, and OBB-occlusion aliases at the recorded RVAs. Raw analysis-image vtable reads independently confirm BSGeometryListCullingProcess slot 0x19, BSShaderAccumulator slot 0x2B, BSBatchRenderer slot 0x03, and the BSOBBOcclusionTestingShader virtual layout. Exact disassembly additionally proves the culling drains and accumulator dispatch paths, the 31-entry render-mode table, and the OBB producer lifecycle from transformed-bound registration through a 36-index instanced stereo-aware draw, GPU-to-staging CopyResource, CPU readback, result reset, and dynamic instance-buffer upload.

The verified Breezehome live capture joins the engine-routed OBBOcclusionTesting 0/0 technique to a depth-only immediate-context submission, a 4096 x 64-byte dynamic input SRV, a 4096 x uint32 result UAV, one 36-index/1588-instance draw for 794 objects, primary-to-staging CopyResource, result version publication, per-frame reset copies, 721 same-version lighting consumers, and 721 following-frame CPU-readback cull decisions (489 visible, 232 occluded).

evidence.statement: The Direct3D 11 Map contract and map-flag contract establish that DO_NOT_WAIT returns DXGI_ERROR_WAS_STILL_DRAWING when the GPU still owns a resource; the Windows allocation-usage contract requires a synchronizing map without that flag to wait until the allocation is available for CPU access. Paired with exact target disassembly showing D3D11_MAP_READ and flags zero, successful return from Skyrim's staging Map is the allocation-scoped CPU-visibility boundary.
